description: Update metadata for an existing vector
embedding_description: Update metadata for an existing vector by id. Provide namespace, vector_id, and new metadata values. Use to add tags or update attributes without changing embeddings. The embedding vector itself is not modified.

result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Replaces the metadata JSON for a single vector in a pgvector namespace; the embedding vector itself is untouched.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: namespace, vector_id, or metadata is missing, or metadata is not JSON-serializable. NotFoundError: no row in the namespace matches the vector_id. DatabaseError: the underlying UPDATE failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Confirm namespace, vector_id, and a JSON-serializable metadata dict are all supplied. A NotFoundError means the vector has been deleted or never existed; do not retry with the same arguments — re-fetch the id via search_similar_action or store_vectors_action first. Retry transient database errors once.
